bugs_found_and_fixed.summary: admit_screenplay_for_direction inserted the adaptation_screenplay_admissions projection row before its own referenced adaptation_decisions row existed, violating fk_adaptation_screenplay_admissions_decision under PostgreSQL's immediate FK enforcement (silently passed under SQLite's disabled FK checks). Fixed by reordering: append_decision_and_advance_head now runs first.
_profile_ref fabricated a policy_pack_digest that never matched a real profile pack, causing ProfilePackRegistry.resolve to fail closed. Fixed by computing the real digest from the pinned pack JSON.

_BarrierBeforeHeadLockRepository barriered every prepare_or_lock_head call including the branch's MAP_APPROVAL lock, deadlocking the harness once real Postgres row-level locking serialized the two racers at their shared SCREENPLAY_ADMISSION head. Fixed by narrowing the barrier to the SCREENPLAY_ADMISSION lock only.
